newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Berg Electronics started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Berg Electronics started.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Thomas Hopkins said he initiated coverage of Berg Electronics Inc with a buy rating and a 12-month target price of $35.
-- His 1996 earnings per share estimate is $1.43, 1997 is $1.85 and fourth quarter 1996 is $0.43.

-- "We believe that Berg will be the connector-group earnings growth leader in 1997 with EPS increase of better than 29 percent (versus 18 percent for the connector group and five percent for the S&P 500) driven by low double-digit top-line growth, gross margin expansion from new products and greater manufacturing efficiencies, as well as pretax margin expansion from deleveraging," Hopkins said in a research note.
-- Shares were up 3/4 at 29-1/2 in late morning exchange trading.
